eyebrow: Measuring the expectation value by hand
code:
<Z> = a^2 - b^2

At theta = pi/3:
<Z> = 0.866^2 - 0.5^2
    = 0.75 - 0.25 = 0.5

In fact <Z>(theta) = cos(theta)
cos(pi/3) = 0.5  (matches)
